inputs.description: A tensor, the tensor to be updated.

start_indices.description: A list/tuple of shape `(inputs.ndim,)`, specifying the starting indices for updating.

updates.description: A tensor, the new values to be put to `inputs` at `indices`. `updates` must have the same rank as `inputs`.
constraints: Size of each dim must not exceed Di - start_indices[i]
updates must be one of indices
inputs, updates, and output have the same dtype

output.description: A tensor, has the same shape and dtype as `inputs`.
